name: com.europeinstead/europe-instead
title: Europe Instead
description: European software alternatives with sourced facts: origin score and data exposure level per tool.

tools.name: find_european_alternatives
tools.description: European software that replaces a non-European product ("Slack", "Google Analytics", "HubSpot"), in Europe Instead's ranking order. Each tool gives an origin score (how European the company is, 0 to 100) and an exposure level (1 to 5, who can reach the customer's data), both from sourced facts. Cite each tool's `page`.

product.description: The non-European product to replace, by name or slug: "Slack", "Google Analytics", "hubspot".

max_level.description: Only tools whose exposure level, for who can reach the customer's data, is at most this (1: European stack; 2: European region, non-European provider; 3: Account or support data leaves Europe; 4: Core data leaves Europe on some paths; 5: Stored outside Europe by default). A level that is only a lower bound, because the subprocessor list is not complete, does not pass.

country.description: Country of the contracting company, as an ISO 3166-1 code ("DE") or an English name ("Germany").

open_source.description: Only tools whose code is published under an open source licence.

limit.description: How many tools to return, at most 25. Default 10.

tools.name: search_european_tools
tools.description: European software tools by name or by category ("crm", "web analytics"), with optional filters on exposure level, country and open source. Needs a query or a category.

category.description: A category by slug or name ("crm", "Web analytics"). See list_categories.

max_level.description: Only tools whose exposure level, for who can reach the customer's data, is at most this (1: European stack; 2: European region, non-European provider; 3: Account or support data leaves Europe; 4: Core data leaves Europe on some paths; 5: Stored outside Europe by default). A level that is only a lower bound, because the subprocessor list is not complete, does not pass.

country.description: Country of the contracting company, as an ISO 3166-1 code ("DE") or an English name ("Germany").

open_source.description: Only tools whose code is published under an open source licence.

limit.description: How many tools to return, at most 25. Default 10.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: One European tool in full: the facts behind its origin score and exposure level, each with its source URL, quoted passage and check date, plus its subprocessors and features.

slug.description: The tool's slug, as returned by the other tools ("plausible").

tools.name: list_replaced_products
tools.description: The non-European products that have European alternatives here, with how many, most first. At most 50; filter with a query.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Software categories with how many European tools each has, most first. At most 50; filter with a query.
